etymologies.etymologyHTML: From pass +‎ word; the sentry-passing sense predates the cryptographic sense and was its inspiration.

definitions.definition: (military, security) A word relayed to a person to gain admittance to a place or to gain access to information.

(computing, cryptography) A string of characters used to log in to a computer or network, to access a level in a video game, and so on; archetypally a word but nowadays often an alphanumeric string or a phrase.
(computing, transitive) To protect with a password.
